# Description
Describe the bug in detail. Include any relevant information about your environment, such as operating system, version of pulse, and any other relevant details.

# Steps to Reproduce
Please provide a clear and concise list of steps to reproduce the bug. Any screenshots or code snippets that can help illustrate the issue are also welcome.

# Expected Behavior
Describe what you expected to happen when you followed the steps above.

# Actual Behavior
Describe what actually happened when you followed the steps above.
